# GIT_REPOSITORY

A git remote, addressed differently from inside and outside the cluster.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `git`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.git`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| cloneUrl | string |
| credentials | null or record { name, namespace, passwordKey, username, usernameKey } |
| externalUrl | string |
| internalUrl | string |
